name: ai-agent-skill
description: Relentless: a persistent, self-improving, evidence-verified Agent Skill for OpenHands Cloud and other compatible agents.

plugins.name: relentless
plugins.description: Persistent, self-improving, evidence-verified execution for every task. Continues through errors, dead ends, or apparent impossibility until all requirements are verifiably satisfied or the user explicitly stops, pauses, or redirects the task.
